item.title: How to backup and restore PVCs with the Kubernetes Operator
item.description: An 18-minute walkthrough of the Plakar Kubernetes Operator: WordPress and MariaDB on EKS, backed up to S3 and restored, every step declared in YAML.

item.title: Resilience as Code, because backup should be Infrastructure.
item.description: Backup is the last layer of your stack still clicked into a console. The Plakar Kubernetes Operator makes it code: declare resilience as Custom Resources, reconciled from Git, for everything you run.
